radio_extra.reinforce: More briar hounds are breaking through the brush from the southern woodline!
radio_extra.low_hp: You're bleeding through your mail, Commander—pull back behind the pikes!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Half the gnoll pack is in the dirt, keep the pressure on the ford!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: The ford is cleared of blood and mud. Tollhouse ledger is safe.

radio_extra.reinforce: Rootbound hulks are lumbering out of the gray mist behind our position!
radio_extra.low_hp: That poison is slowing your stride, take a draught of sweet water now!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The willow nests are burning down; we have broken their ambush line.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Scout Bren is on the litter. The peat fog hides our retreat no longer.

radio_extra.reinforce: Quill fiends are swarming over the outer wall from the pine shadows!
radio_extra.low_hp: Your shield-arm is wavering, Captain—let the levymen take the front rank!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two bone totems are smashed to splinters; the witchfire is dimming.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Ravenwatch bailey holds another night against the dark.

radio_extra.reinforce: More drowned thralls are boiling up through the flooded cloister floor!
radio_extra.low_hp: The chill water is stealing your strength, stay away from the deep silt!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Mordred's altar is fouled with his own guard's blood.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Old Briarmaw rises from the black sump, jaws dripping with ancient mud!
radio_extra.boss_low: The beast's massive hide is torn—strike the heart before it drags us down!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: The sunken sanctum rests in silence once more.

radio_extra.reinforce: Cinderlings are dropping onto the switchback from the upper crags!
radio_extra.low_hp: You're taking too many arrows on the climb, crouch behind the mail wagon!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The lower deadfall is cleared and Courier Corin is moving.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Lantern Passage beacon burns clear against the midnight sky.

radio_extra.reinforce: Flintbacks are charging out of the timber stacks to defend Tarn's powder!
radio_extra.low_hp: Step back from the salted rations before your wounds foul the meat!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two timber depots are blazing; Tarn's reserves are cut in half.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Greywood supply depots are reduced to black craters.

radio_extra.reinforce: Glasswings are diving from the granite horn straight into our left wing!
radio_extra.low_hp: The frost is biting deep into your cuts, keep moving to stay warm!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both alpine gorges are cleared of the stone sentinels.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Twin Cairns stand lit against the mountain gale.

radio_extra.reinforce: Rootbound breakers are splashing across the swollen river from the east bank!
radio_extra.low_hp: The pike line is thinning around you, do not let them break the bridgehead!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Three raider waves have broken against our stakes and bled out.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Every refugee cart is safe across Alder Bridge.

radio_extra.reinforce: More flintbacks are pouring out of the old kiln smoke to support Krag!
radio_extra.low_hp: Ironhide's maul has cracked your ribs, fall back behind the spearmen!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Krag's outriders are wiped from the quarry floor.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Krag Ironhide steps from the peat smoke, swinging his rune-baked maul!
radio_extra.boss_low: The warlord's hide is cracking! One good push will drop him!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: The granite quarry belongs to the living again.

radio_extra.reinforce: Fallen shamans are crawling out of the dark ventilation shafts!
radio_extra.low_hp: The underground air is foul and your blood is running thin, watch your guard!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two ventilated galleries are purged of the blood-cultists.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: The Undervault links are cleared from snow to southern stair.

radio_extra.reinforce: Gloom stags are leaping over the burning barricades into the town square!
radio_extra.low_hp: Ashbrook is burning around you, find cover before the roof beams fall!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The evacuation wagons are rolling unmolested up the north road.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Morvessa descends from the ridge like a storm-cloud of cold iron!
radio_extra.boss_low: Morvessa's dark sorcery is failing—finish the turncoat witch!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Ashbrook's gates are shut against the ashes.

radio_extra.reinforce: Sand raiders are boiling out of the alkali hollows on lathered mounts!
radio_extra.low_hp: The desert heat is draining your stamina, find shadow by the obelisk!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two bone-pit outposts are smoking heaps in the salt.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Redmarsh border is crossed and the causeway holds.

radio_extra.reinforce: Claw vipers are slithering down the red granite goat-trails behind us!
radio_extra.low_hp: Poison is blackening your veins, drink the antidote phial now!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both high horn-bow blinds are silent and abandoned.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Twin passes are opened to our vanguard.

radio_extra.reinforce: Storm kites are screeching down through the copper dust storm!
radio_extra.low_hp: The grit is scouring the flesh from your face, keep your visor down!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two scout squads are secured; one ring remains in the grit.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: All scattered scouts are gathered behind the boulder rings.

radio_extra.reinforce: Witch doctors are chanting up the dry creek bed with fresh firepots!
radio_extra.low_hp: Highgate catwalks are slippery with your blood, step carefully!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The scaling ladders are smashed into kindling along the palisade.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Highgate Watch stands tall against the desert night.

radio_extra.reinforce: Greater mummies are rising from the alkali crust around the quartz spires!
radio_extra.low_hp: The black blood from the spires is rotting your armor away!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two ward-breaking circles are smashed to white dust.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Lady Selene steps from the bleeding quartz, wreathed in frost and malice!
radio_extra.boss_low: Selene's ice is melting! Strike hard while she stumbles!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Wardstone spires hum with pure light once more.

radio_extra.reinforce: Claw vipers are burrowing beneath the wagon wheels in the deep mire!
radio_extra.low_hp: An axle is groaning and you are bleeding out—defend the supply crates!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Half the Sunken Causeway is behind us with all wheels rolling.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Mire convoy is safely inside the forward camp.

radio_extra.reinforce: Dune beasts are charging through the blinding smoke of the smokers!
radio_extra.low_hp: The sulfur smoke is choking the breath from your lungs, pull back!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The assay vault is looted and half the grain stacks are burning.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Granary box canyon is a scorched imperial memory.

radio_extra.reinforce: Fetish blowdart gunners are creeping through the poison willow thicket!
radio_extra.low_hp: The marrow-rot fumes are bypassing your wet cloth, get out of the haze!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Ten black megaliths are overturned; Saelen's circle is broken.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Matriarch Voss emerges from the fetid roots, rattling bone trinkets!
radio_extra.boss_low: The Matriarch's hexes are breaking over her head—strike now!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Hexer's hollow is cleansed of root and rot.

radio_extra.reinforce: Pale burrowers are tunneling up through the quarry switchback ramps!
radio_extra.low_hp: Stone dust and blood make a thick paste on your armor, stay steady!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The upper ballista ledges are quiet and the slave-pens are open.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Deep Quarry miners are free of Gorrathul's chains.

radio_extra.reinforce: Salt crabs are scuttling up the half-built stone revetments!
radio_extra.low_hp: Crossroads Redoubt is nearly overwhelmed, do not let them touch the well!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two raider columns have broken their teeth on our revetments.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Lean garrison holds the crossroads until relief arrives.

radio_extra.reinforce: Dune lurkers are dropping from the gorge walls to block Vorn's pursuers!
radio_extra.low_hp: You're sprinting hard on empty lungs, catch Vorn before the gates drop!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Vorn's rearguard is scattered across the gravel trail.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Gorrathul's fortress blueprints are secured from Vorn's cold hands.

radio_extra.reinforce: Greater mummies are marching out of Ironheart's gatehouse to reinforce the bridge!
radio_extra.low_hp: The citadel guns are pounding the causeway into dust around you!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The eastern gun redoubts are smashed and silent.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Gorrathul steps onto the causeway, clad in plates of dark forged iron!
radio_extra.boss_low: Gorrathul's iron plate is dented and bare! Take his head!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Ironheart Bastion's gates lie open to our banners.

radio_extra.reinforce: Hollow knights are wading through the Greywash mudflats toward our flank!
radio_extra.low_hp: The tide is rising fast and your wounds are open, reach the jetties!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The blockade pontoons are burning down to the waterline.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Oakhaven channel flies our colors once more.

radio_extra.reinforce: Spore matrons are puffing boiling steam across the basalt clifftops!
radio_extra.low_hp: Your wet wool mask is scorched through, the sulfur is burning your throat!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two outer ward-rings are shattered into basalt rubble.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Cinder Wards are cooled and the groundwater flows pure.

radio_extra.reinforce: Ironbark constructs are marching down from Split Tooth ridge!
radio_extra.low_hp: The arbalest bolts are splintering your tower-shield to matchwood!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both flanking arbalest batteries are smashed into the granite.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Split Tooth road is clear of sniper fire.

radio_extra.reinforce: Hollow knights are breaking through the ruined chapel graveyard fence!
radio_extra.low_hp: Levymen are falling around the stretchers, hold the bracken line!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Most of the wounded are loaded; the triage wagon is ready.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Field infirmary has evacuated every crippled soldier.

radio_extra.reinforce: Salt crabs are swarming up the lower lighthouse stair out of the surf!
radio_extra.low_hp: The sea-stack is chin-deep in freezing brine, swim or die!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The drowned armory is looted and the water-gate is blown.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Malakor the Drowned rises from the crashing surf, armored in barnacles and rust!
radio_extra.boss_low: Malakor's coral shell is cracking! Drive him back into the tide!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Sunken Citadel Castellan lies still on the lighthouse landing.

radio_extra.reinforce: Hollow kings are blocking the canyon exit with animated deadfall!
radio_extra.low_hp: You're running on fumes and fourteen bolts, keep the pace up!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two canyon roadblocks are hacked to splinters.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Iron-Gate Watchtower is relieved from its long siege.

radio_extra.reinforce: Wendigo bruisers are crashing through the switchback timber lines!
radio_extra.low_hp: The chalk walls offer no shelter against their sortie, fight for your life!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both mule-train ambushes succeeded; the garrison is starving.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: High-Orchard Redoubt surrenders its keys to the frost.

radio_extra.reinforce: Lantern eels are writhing up through the sluice grates from the dark river!
radio_extra.low_hp: Eighty feet of roaring water is below you, do not lose your footing!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The central sluice island is secured and the gears are wedged.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Riverlock Crossing floodgates are locked in our favor.

radio_extra.reinforce: Spore matrons are releasing toxic cloud cover across the pine ridge!
radio_extra.low_hp: The colossus's tectonic stomps have broken your armor plates to scrap!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The giant's granite plating is cracked down the spine.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: The Peat Monolith heaves itself upright from the ancient bog, shaking the pines!
radio_extra.boss_low: The Monolith's core is sputtering slag! One final push!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Elder Juggernaut lies shattered across the ridge.

radio_extra.reinforce: Night orchards are hurling screaming skull-fruit over Vane's manor wall!
radio_extra.low_hp: Vane's catacomb guards are closing in while you bleed on the flagstones!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both flanking manor vaults are secured and the bullion is bagged.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Captain Draven strides from the catacomb lift, brandishing a poisoned sabre!
radio_extra.boss_low: Draven is bleeding heavily from his own vaults—cut him down!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Baron Vane's extortion ring is broken forever.

radio_extra.reinforce: Frost bells are chiming an eerie warning across the muddy salvage hollow!
radio_extra.low_hp: Two mercenary bands are carving you up in the crossfire, find cover!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The warband standards are lying in the mud between the corpses.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Clashing banners are trampled into the harbor muck.

radio_extra.reinforce: Wendigo bruisers are leaping from the burning drydocks onto the seawall!
radio_extra.low_hp: The pitch-pots are setting your cloak ablaze, beat out the fire!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The Western Evacuation Pier holds and the refugee caravels are clearing the bay.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Lord-Captain Korvus drags his twin iron anchors onto the Eastern War Pier, roaring defiance!
radio_extra.boss_low: Korvus's heavy chains are fouling in the ash! Cast The Iron Anchor into the surf!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Burning Harbor's western quay held long enough for the fleet to sail.

radio_extra.reinforce: Crowned maws are erupting from the black glass sand drifts!
radio_extra.low_hp: The volcanic cinders are scouring your wounds, bind them tight!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The ash-stalker packs are wiped from the dunes.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Highcrest bluff is fortified against the heartland night.

radio_extra.reinforce: Rift moths are swarming out of the static dome to feed on our spells!
radio_extra.low_hp: Lightning arcs are dancing across your chest plate, step away from the prisms!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two crystal focusing beacons are smashed into glass powder.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Shattered beacons leave the obsidian pass wide open.

radio_extra.reinforce: Anvilmaw smiths are hauling heavy iron scaling ladders up the glacis!
radio_extra.low_hp: Greystone's pumice wall is crumbling beneath your feet, hold the gap!
radio_extra.half_cleared: All scaling ladders are tipped into the ditch.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Besieged wall is cleared of every siege engine.

radio_extra.reinforce: Doom knights are materializing behind our advance on the Ashveil gorge!
radio_extra.low_hp: Malrik's obsidian barriers are grinding your shield arm to bone!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The shadow constructs are fading back into the gorge walls.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Flight of Malrik ends upon the blood-stained portal stairs.

radio_extra.reinforce: Silt colossi are trampling the blind scree behind the twin crag bastions!
radio_extra.low_hp: The mana-cannon volleys are shaking the very cliffside loose!
radio_extra.half_cleared: One crag bastion gun is spiked and silent.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: The High-Tide Oracle rises from the citadel mists, chanting curses of salt and iron!
radio_extra.boss_low: The Oracle's tides are receding—strike before the next chant!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Twofold assault leaves the citadel causeway open.

radio_extra.reinforce: Basalt brutes are blocking the magnetic canyon road with heavy portcullis beams!
radio_extra.low_hp: Your weapons are leaping to the canyon walls from magnetic pull, fight bare-handed if you must!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Two spiked gates are cracked and the golems are scrap.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Gauntlet of iron is passed and the cliff nests are stripped.

radio_extra.reinforce: Redglass drakes are swooping out of the magma moat across the battlements!
radio_extra.low_hp: The heat from the slag river is melting your greaves, move faster!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both gatehouse counterweight winches are cut and dropped.
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Outer rampart drawbridge spans the fire.

radio_extra.reinforce: Crowned maws are surging across the ash plain from the eastern relief host!
radio_extra.low_hp: Three armies are crushing our camp, do not let the line buckle!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The northern column and western powder convoy are obliterated.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: The Ironclad Leviathan crawls across the ash plains, bristling with heavy ballistas!
radio_extra.boss_low: The Leviathan's iron plates are buckling! Pour everything into the breach!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Three-roads siege ends in a field of broken standards.

radio_extra.reinforce: Rift moths are streaming out of the twin doors of the obsidian nave!
radio_extra.low_hp: The silent praetors have driven their spears through your armor, stay on your feet!
radio_extra.half_cleared: The praetor phalanx is broken and the central dais is clear.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Inquisitor Varro steps through the silver steles, eyes burning with zealot fire!
radio_extra.boss_low: Varro's faith is cracking under your blade—end the Inquisitor!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Threshold Choice is made within the silent nave.

radio_extra.reinforce: Stormtrees are smashing their root-clubs down onto the marble altar seals!
radio_extra.low_hp: Shadow praetorians have surrounded the vault dome, fight your way to the seals!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both West and East Anchor Seals are holding against the surge.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: Vesperion descends from the cracked dome, wings of pure starlight blazing with wrath!
radio_extra.boss_low: Vesperion's starlight is dimming to ash—strike true!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Crown of Order rests immovable upon the fractured altar.

radio_extra.reinforce: Anvilmaw smiths are swarming out of the splitting floor vents around the throne!
radio_extra.low_hp: The unchained primordial fire is melting the floor beneath your boots!
radio_extra.half_cleared: Both West and East Conduit Pillars are reduced to slag.
radio_extra.boss_spawn: First Warden Ashkarath rises from the Obsidian Throne, wreathed in unchained magma!
radio_extra.boss_low: Ashkarath's primordial flame is guttering out! Strike the final blow!
radio_extra.victory_flavour: Ember Reckoning is complete. The realm belongs to the dawn.
